commands.command: /bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'lemma (wf|lc)|inductive LC|def dlookup' Cslib/Languages/LambdaCalculus/LocallyNameless/Fsub/{Subtype,Type,Term,Environment,Context}.lean 2>/dev/null; head -95 Cslib/Languages/LambdaCalculus/LocallyNameless/Fsub/Subtype.lean; ls Cslib/Languages/LambdaCalculus/LocallyNameless/Fsub; rg -n 'rcases .* with' Cslib/Languages/LambdaCalculus | head; for d in ../cslib-v4.3*; do printf '\\n%s\\n' \""'$d"; sed -n '"'75,110p' \""'$d/Cslib/Languages/LambdaCalculus/LocallyNameless/Fsub/Reduction.lean"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -A 8 -B 4 '(lemma.*lc|dlookup_nil|inductive LC)' Cslib/Languages/LambdaCalculus/LocallyNameless/Fsub/WellFormed.lean Cslib/Languages/LambdaCalculus/LocallyNameless/Fsub/Basic.lean; rg -n 'lemma dlookup_nil|theorem dlookup_nil' Cslib .lake/packages/batteries/Batteries .lake/packages/mathlib/Mathlib 2>/dev/null | head -20; head -40 Cslib/Languages/LambdaCalculus/LocallyNameless/Fsub/Basic.lean; for d in /localhome/milikic/proof-reduction-competition/.proof-eval-projects/cslib-v4.31.0 /localhome/milikic/proof-reduction-competition/.proof-eval-projects/cslib-v4.32.0; do diff -u Cslib/Languages/LambdaCalculus/LocallyNameless/Fsub/Typing.lean \""'$d/Cslib/Languages/LambdaCalculus/LocallyNameless/Fsub/Typing.lean" | head -60; done'

/bin/bash -lc "cat > candidate.lean <<'EOF'
lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have der' := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => cases mem
  case abs => exact .inl (.abs der'.wf.2.1)
  case tabs => exact .inl (.tabs der'.wf.2.1)
  case app l r ih_l ih_r =>
    right
    rcases ih_l rfl l with v | ⟨_, h⟩
    · rcases ih_r rfl r with w | ⟨_, h⟩
      · obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs v
        exact ⟨_, .abs v.lc w⟩
      · exact ⟨_, .appᵣ v h⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .appₗ r.wf.2.1 h⟩
  case tapp der sub ih =>
    right
    have lc := (Sub.wf _ _ _ sub).2.1.lc
    rcases ih rfl der with v | ⟨_, h⟩
    · obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs v
      exact ⟨_, .tabs v.lc lc⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .tapp lc h⟩
  case let' der _ ih _ =>
    right
    have b := (body_let.mp der'.wf.2.1).2
    rcases ih rfl der with v | ⟨_, h⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .let_body v b⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .let_bind h b⟩
  case inl der _ ih =>
    rcases ih rfl der with v | ⟨_, h⟩
    · exact .inl (.inl v)
    · exact .inr ⟨_, .inl h⟩
  case inr der _ ih =>
    rcases ih rfl der with v | ⟨_, h⟩
    · exact .inl (.inr v)
    · exact .inr ⟨_, .inr h⟩
  case case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    right
    obtain ⟨_, b₂, b₃⟩ := body_case.mp der'.wf.2.1
    rcases ih rfl der with v | ⟨_, h⟩
    · obtain ⟨_, rfl | rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum v
      · cases v with
        | inl v => exact ⟨_, .case_inl v b₂ b₃⟩
      · cases v with
        | inr v => exact ⟨_, .case_inr v b₂ b₃⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .case h b₂ b₃⟩
  case sub der _ ih => exact ih rfl der
EOF
python check_candidate.py candidate.lean"

method_note: Shell commands and visible correctness outcomes only; no reasoning text. rg/sed is a literal command-presence indicator, not a semantic retrieval score.
